items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: We went out I think for more than a year ... with Lucky's band.

ctx.x: How long would you all, you know when you would leave New York, about how long would you all stay out on the road?
I don't know. We went out I think for more than a year ... with Lucky's band.
What was your impression of people like Paul Whiteman and Benny Goodman?
